title: REJECTED: the Twilio auth token does not reach exception text, tracebacks or the error log
method: live twilio client instantiation, forced 401, plus review of the setup-error.txt path
observed_at_discovery: Checked the three paths a credential could reach a file or a screen and none of them carry it. (1) CuraVoice.call() stores str(e) in CallResult.error. Instantiated a real twilio.rest.Client with a known token and forced a 401: repr(client) is '<Twilio AC1111...>', str(e) is 'HTTP 401 error: Unable to create record: Authenticate', and the token appears in neither str(e) nor traceback.format_exc(). (2) packaging/cura_setup_app.py writes traceback.format_exc() to ~/.cura/setup-error.txt and tells the caregiver to email that file onward; format_exception emits source lines, not local values, so the token cannot appear there. (3) No logging.basicConfig or FileHandler exists anywhere in the package, so nothing is written to a log file at all. git grep for AC[0-9a-f]{32} and hardcoded tokens over the tree: no matches; ~/.cura is outside the repo and cannot be committed. Rejected so the next audit does not re-run this. The real credential exposure is the file permissions -- see FS-2523bb0a6b27 and FS-41eb5e1d0c36.
